label: fig:method
text: Overall methodology. The three distributed files are first traced to their published sources and audited for duplication, label conflict and training-test overlap; cleaning produces Benchmark_clean; every model is then scored under three evaluation regimes that progressively remove overlap between the training collection and the test sets. Hatching distinguishes the audit steps (dotted) and the evaluation regimes (diagonal); dashed outlines mark the modelling steps.

label: tab:dataset_composition
text: Composition of the three distributed files and of the cleaned training collection (Benchmark_clean, Section 3.3). Source: results/data_audit.csv.

label: tab:provenance
text: Provenance of the three local files, established by comparison with the downloaded original files. Source: results/provenance.csv.

label: fig:lineage
text: Provenance of the three files and the origin of the overlap. A: inside each resource the training and test sets share no sequence. B: the distributed training file combines the AIPpred benchmark with 612 AntiInflam training sequences, so each resource's test set meets the other resource's training data, and 211 of the 425 sequences of Ind_425 and 298 of the 1,049 of Ind_1049 occur in the training file. Counts from results/tables/T3.5_cross_benchmark_leakage.csv and results/provenance.csv.

label: tab:conflicts
text: Duplicates and label conflicts in Benchmark_Dataset and their origin. Sources: results/data_audit.csv and results/v2/lineage_shared_training.csv.

label: tab:overlap
text: Exact overlap between each training set and each independent set, by direction, with the number of independent-set sequences at identity of 0.9 or more to the training set. Percentages are of the independent set. Source: results/tables/T3.5_cross_benchmark_leakage.csv.

label: tab:hashes
text: SHA-256 digests of the local data files and of the files in the AIPFusion-Net repository, downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com/ChenYH7693/AIPFusion-Net/main/AIPData/ on 2026-11-26. Source: results/v2/aipfusion_repo_check.csv.

label: fig:regimes
text: The three evaluation regimes. Bar length is the number of test sequences that survive each regime, and the hatching distinguishes them; the counts are those of Table 3.7. Only the test sets change: the training collection is the same in all three.

label: tab:identity
text: Identity screen of the independent sets against Benchmark_clean, and the shuffled-composition null control. Sources: results/identity_screen.csv and results/v2/null_control_identity.csv.

label: tab:esm
text: The ESM-2 checkpoints used as frozen feature extractors. Embedding times are single measurements for all unique sequences on the CPU of the machine used. Source: results/embedding_timings.csv and results/v2/methods_parameters.csv.

label: tab:pooling
text: Pooling variants compared on frozen ESM-2 650M embeddings. Dimensions from results/v2/pooling_dimensions.csv.

label: tab:finetune
text: Fine-tuning protocol for the ESM-2 8M checkpoint and its frozen control. Source: results/v2/methods_parameters.csv.

label: fig:aipnet
text: The network used for the mean-pooled reference model B1. The frozen ESM-2 encoder is used as a feature extractor only; one shared encoder feeds two heads, so the cross-entropy gradient (solid) and the contrastive gradient (dashed) update the same representation. The weight λ sets how much the contrastive term contributes.

label: fig:splits
text: Cross-validation and splitting protocol. Each of the five folds is held out in turn (cross-hatched); the scaler and the positive-class weight are fitted on the training part of that fold only and then applied to the held-out part, so no information from the held-out peptides reaches the model. The folds are redrawn for each of five seeds, giving 25 runs per configuration. Final models (dashed) are trained on all of Benchmark_clean with a stratified 10 per cent hold-out for early stopping.

label: tab:training
text: Training settings of the multilayer perceptron and of the residue-level models. Source: results/v2/methods_parameters.csv.

label: tab:mde
text: Minimum detectable effect (80% power, two-sided α = 0.05) of the paired comparisons of λ > 0 with λ = 0 for each test set and regime. Source: results/v2/mde_summary.csv, derived from results/tables/T5.11_corrected_significance.csv.
